official.deadline_note: The Ministry invites applications annually; the 2026 round closed on 6 August 2026 and no 2027 closing date has been published yet.
official.status_note: Completed application forms for the 2026 round had to be submitted no later than August 6, 2026; the Ministry publishes a new call each year.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 'Full tuition fees, payable directly to the University.'
benefits: Full tuition fees, payable directly to the University
One (1) direct economy class ticket to the country of study at the commencement of the course, and one (1) return ticket to Barbados on completion of the programme
Living allowance of $6,300.00 per annum for students pursuing studies in the USA
Living allowance of $5,880.00 per annum for students pursuing studies in Canada
Living allowance of $7,560.00 per annum for students pursuing studies in the United Kingdom
eligibility: Have been accepted at an accredited institution
Be students of the newer secondary schools on the Ministry's published list
Study in one of the funded areas: Marine Studies, Aeronautics or Culinary Arts
Apply at undergraduate or postgraduate level
requirements: Submit the completed Scholarship_Fellowship_Application_Form obtained from the Ministry
Submit before the published closing date; incomplete applications will not be accepted
Successful applicants must enter a bond with sureties to return and work in Barbados on completion of the course, on the basis of one year for each year of the award
selection_criteria: Awards are made in three named areas only: Marine Studies, Aeronautics and Culinary Arts
Only students of the newer secondary schools on the Ministry's published list may apply
coverage: Full tuition fees, payable directly to the University
One direct economy class ticket to the country of study and one return ticket to Barbados on completion
application_method: Download the Scholarship_Fellowship_Application_Form.pdf from the Ministry's scholarship page, or obtain it from the Tertiary Section
Check the Ministry's published list of newer secondary schools to confirm your school is eligible
Submit the completed form to the Tertiary Section, Ministry of Education Transformation, Elsie Payne Complex, Constitution Road, St. Michael, or by email to tertiary@mes.gov.bb (535-0863 / 850-4802)
official.application_route: Download the Ministry's Scholarship_Fellowship_Application_Form, complete it in full and lodge it with the Tertiary Section in person or by email to tertiary@mes.gov.bb before the closing date.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be citizens of Barbados.
official.international_eligibility: Not open to international students; the notice invites applications from suitably qualified Barbadians.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Studies must be in Marine Studies, Aeronautics or Culinary Arts at an accredited institution, and applicants must be students of the newer secondary schools on the Ministry's published list.
official.description: The Errol Walton Barrow Scholarships are a Government of Barbados award administered by the Ministry of Education Transformation for citizens of Barbados from the country's newer secondary schools, supporting undergraduate and postgraduate study in marine studies, aeronautics or culinary arts at an accredited institution.

not_confirmed: funding_amount and funding_currency - living allowances are published as $6,300.00 (USA), $5,880.00 (Canada) and $7,560.00 (United Kingdom) per annum with no currency stated
documents - the notice directs applicants to the Scholarship_Fellowship_Application_Form.pdf without listing attachments
selection criteria beyond the field and school restrictions
verification.notes: Values, eligibility, the bond obligation, the submission route and the 6 August 2026 closing date were read directly from the Ministry's 2026 Errol Walton Barrow Scholarships notice.

applicant_utility.summary: The single biggest filter is your school: only students of the newer secondary schools on the Ministry's published list may apply, so confirm your school by name against that PDF before anything else. The award is also field-locked to Marine Studies, Aeronautics and Culinary Arts, and it carries a bond with sureties requiring you to return and work in Barbados for one year for every year funded - so you need a guarantor as well as an offer. Plan around an annual cycle: the 2026 round closed on 6 August 2026, and the Ministry publishes the next call on its news page rather than on a fixed calendar.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Barbadian students from a listed newer secondary school who already hold, or are about to hold, an offer in marine studies, aeronautics or culinary arts and who can find sureties for the return-service bond.
application_readiness_checklist: Download the Ministry's list of newer secondary schools and confirm your school appears on it by name
Confirm your intended subject sits inside the three funded areas, at either undergraduate or postgraduate level
Secure acceptance at an accredited institution before applying, since the notice requires it
Identify sureties willing to sign the return-service bond before you accept an offer
Complete every section of the Scholarship_Fellowship_Application_Form, because incomplete applications are rejected outright
Watch the Ministry's news page from mid-year for the next call, since dates are not published in advance
common_rejection_risks: Applying from a secondary school that is not on the Ministry's newer-secondary-schools list
Choosing a subject outside the three named areas, however strong the rest of the file
Not holding acceptance at an accredited institution at the time of application
Submitting an incomplete application form, which the Ministry states it will not accept
Being unable to produce sureties for the bond, which effectively blocks acceptance of the award
Missing the closing date because the round is short and the date is only announced in the call
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Books, equipment, insurance, visa and residence costs, and general living costs above the fixed per-annum allowance; only tuition, the allowance and two tickets are published as covered.
document_audit: Use the current Scholarship_Fellowship_Application_Form downloaded from the Ministry's page rather than an older copy passed around your school
The newer-secondary-schools list is a separate PDF linked from the notice - check it rather than relying on what your school tells you
Incomplete applications are not accepted, so verify every field and signature before submission
The bond needs sureties, so confirm their availability and willingness before you celebrate an offer
Submissions go to the Tertiary Section at the Elsie Payne Complex or by email to tertiary@mes.gov.bb - keep the email confirmation as proof of filing
alerts: The bond commits you to one year of work in Barbados for each year of the award, with sureties standing behind it
The 2026 cycle closed on 6 August 2026 and no 2027 date is published yet, so monitor the Ministry's news page
The living allowance differs by destination: USA $6,300 per annum, Canada $5,880, United Kingdom $7,560 - the same degree costs you differently depending on where you study
Tickets are provided at the start of the course and on completion, not for visits home in between
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Download and complete the Ministry's application form, lodge it with the Tertiary Section at the Elsie Payne Complex or by email to tertiary@mes.gov.bb before the closing date, and await the Ministry's decision on the annual round.
